digest.component_or_area: container plan-review attestation and scope inheritance
propositions: Declared `none` children must be treated as neutral in drift-scope inheritance, contributing no paths and not poisoning sibling path declarations
Live `undeclared` children poison child inheritance and prevent whole-container all-none promotion, while live `none` children do not
Manifest dependencies and scope must respect exact precedence: own paths > cited paths > inherited paths > explicit parent `none` > all-live-children-none promotion > unscoped
Cheap resign via relation snapshot must preserve the same child-derived signed scope as normal plan-review signing without network fetches
P9 linting must pass declared-none leaves and containers with all-declared children, advising only live undeclared children with both path-declaration and `--none` remedies
